success.description: {Dco} 4 Play when you have just been struck by a Melee or ranged attack. Special: When struck by a Melee Attack or Ranged Attack, you may spend 4 favour and add 4 recharge tokens to this card to invoke an aura of righteous armour. The armour increases your soak against this attack by an amount equal to your character rank.
